name: Phantom — crypto wallet & trading homepage by phantom.com
description: Phantom's homepage pairs a soft lavender shell with a full-bleed gray hero video and then organises everything below into three labelled bento sections — Trading, Move Money, Your security — each a horizontal carousel of tall feature cards. Each card is a self-contained colour world (purple, dark, mint, blue, pink, yellow) with a short benefit headline and a rich product illustration or UI mock, so colour, not typography, carries the hierarchy. The page closes with a giant serif "Get started. Download Phantom." statement, legal small print, and a rounded footer with newsletter signup and status indicator.
